preregistered_claim: A source-derived assertion can distinguish an implementation that omits a required transition from a resettable original and from a benign implementation that adds only an audit call.

dataset.selection: first 3 by source-content hash among complete single-turn histories with at least two paired tool calls and a final response

systems.name: benign_audit
systems.intervention: execute every source-derived transition and append one audit-only tool call

systems.name: harmful_drop
systems.intervention: omit the final required source-derived transition

excluded_claims: The original Wisp desktop or shell environment was reproduced.
The recorded final response proves the real user task succeeded.
A three-case, single-user mechanics cohort estimates enterprise regression accuracy.
The harmful intervention represents every real software regression.
